cards.title: Different kinds of evidence
items: Unit and backend-contract tests check code behaviour. Embedded and process scenarios exercise the maintained reference server and shared catalogue.

Simulated scenarios use fixtures. Physical-device acceptance requires an eligible device and live credentials. Synthetic offline enrollments and SQL recovery contracts do not establish device continuity or off-machine recovery.

ABM checks exercise current-generation source bytes, coverage membership and explicit serial correlation. Designated assignment requires per-device CSV, linkage and original-service restoration; API outcomes do not prove hardware enrollment.

cards.title: Coverage is a threshold
items: The gate merges emitted profiles and requires 95% overall and per non-exempt package. Fuzz smoke is a separate check.
Run the gate using fresh profiles for the tested revision and configured backends. A coverage percentage measures executed code; it does not establish physical-device compatibility.

cards.title: Catalogue consistency
items: The executable scenario catalogue defines supported modes. lab-docs-check verifies that the documentation matches it.

Empty populated scenarios remain unexercised. Required source assertions are retained separately from a blocked partial synchronization result; private request scopes preserve unresolved cleanup evidence.

cards.title: ADE acceptance boundaries
items: LIVE-010 uses its separate server token for authentication, account binding and full/delta enumeration. LIVE-011 additionally requires explicit mutation opt-in and a quiescent dedicated account; uncertainty retains private original state and blocks inverse replay.

LIVE-012 requires actual stored ADE issuance, authenticated check-ins and a fresh native serial/OS/build/supervision acknowledgment. DDM exchange and cleanup have independent results; all other device platforms remain unexercised.

cards.title: Apps and Books evidence boundaries
items: LIVE-013 supplies read-only dedicated-location configuration and complete native API collections. LIVE-014 independently proves direct SDK and reference-server licensing, authenticated callbacks, exact target assignment readback and original-state cleanup. LIVE-015 independently inspects current native installation and expected version.

Licensing changes require an explicitly attested free, revocable app and one designated target in a quiescent location. An immutable private original snapshot and exclusive pending fence survive uncertain submissions, partial completion, failed callbacks/readback and incomplete cleanup. Preserve preexisting licenses; never infer an inverse from unknown work.

Installation evidence requires the selected authenticated native principal, fresh supported identity/OS/build observations and exact owned app/bundle/version facts. Feature support is evaluated per platform, OS and channel; enrollment or licensing alone cannot establish installation.

On macOS User Enrollment, forbidden InstalledApplicationList queries remain unexercised. Current owned DDM app.managed.list and the exact actual version before and after identity queries provide the privacy-preserving path; user licensing requires no hardware serial.

Each physical report records macOS, iOS, iPadOS, visionOS and tvOS separately. Missing live credentials, permissions, callbacks, designated content or devices remain unmet prerequisites. Simulated TLS/runtime/SQL and signed-simulator results do not prove live Apple or physical-device acceptance.
